# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(msigdbr)
library(ReactomePA)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"
wd_mrna  <- "F:/wd/Mm_Bulk_RNA-seq"

tissues <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

# miRNA cluster colors (consistent with 03_ circus plot)
cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD",
  "2" = "#FDCDAC",
  "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4",
  "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

# Enrichment thresholds
PVAL_CUTOFF <- 0.05
QVAL_CUTOFF <- 0.20
MIN_GSET    <- 5
MAX_GSET    <- 500
MIN_GENES   <- 3   # minimum genes in a cluster to attempt enrichment

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04_GO_KEGG", date_str)
dir_go       <- file.path(dir_output, "GO")
dir_kegg     <- file.path(dir_output, "KEGG")
dir_msigdb   <- file.path(dir_output, "MSigDB")
dir_reactome <- file.path(dir_output, "Reactome")
for (d in c(dir_go, dir_kegg, dir_msigdb, dir_reactome))
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("GO       output:", dir_go,       "\n")
cat("KEGG     output:", dir_kegg,     "\n")
cat("MSigDB   output:", dir_msigdb,   "\n")
cat("Reactome output:", dir_reactome, "\n")

# MSigDB collections to test (category + subcategory pairs)
MSIGDB_SETS <- list(
  list(category = "H",  subcategory = NULL,         label = "Hallmark"),
  list(category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:KEGG",    label = "C2_KEGG"),
  list(category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME", label = "C2_Reactome"),
  list(category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:WIKIPATHWAYS", label = "C2_WikiPathways")
)
```

# 3. Helper functions

```{r helpers}
find_masigpro_dir <- function(tissue) {
  base      <- file.path(wd_mrna, "output", tissue)
  all_dated <- sort(
    list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)[
      grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
            basename(list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)))],
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
  for (d in all_dated) {
    cand <- file.path(d, "maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3")
    if (dir.exists(cand)) return(cand)
  }
  stop(paste("maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3 not found:", tissue))
}

find_union_pairs_csv <- function() {
  base      <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "02_integration")
  all_dated <- sort(list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE),
                    decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in all_dated) {
    f <- file.path(d, "union", "negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv")
    if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
  }
  stop("negative_cosine_pairs_union.csv not found")
}

# Return path to {tissue}_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv:
# 1. output/{tissue}/{tissue}_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv (direct)
# 2. output/{tissue}/{date}/{tissue}_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv (latest dated dir)
find_nonzero_csv <- function(tissue) {
  fname  <- paste0(tissue, "_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv")
  direct <- file.path(wd_mrna, "output", tissue, fname)
  if (file.exists(direct)) return(direct)

  base      <- file.path(wd_mrna, "output", tissue)
  all_dated <- sort(
    list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)[
      grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
            basename(list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)))],
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
  for (d in all_dated) {
    f <- file.path(d, fname)
    if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
  }
  stop(paste("nonzero_Log2TPM.csv not found:", tissue))
}

symbol_to_entrez <- function(symbols) {
  ids <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = unique(symbols),
                column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "SYMBOL",
                multiVals = "first")
  unname(ids[!is.na(ids)])
}

# Run GO BP enrichment with simplify(); return NULL if no significant results
run_go <- function(genes, universe) {
  if (length(genes) < MIN_GENES) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch(
    enrichGO(
      gene          = genes,
      universe      = universe,
      OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = PVAL_CUTOFF,
      qvalueCutoff  = QVAL_CUTOFF,
      minGSSize     = MIN_GSET,
      maxGSSize     = MAX_GSET,
      readable      = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res@result) == 0 ||
      sum(res@result$p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF) == 0) return(NULL)
  # Reduce redundant GO terms by semantic similarity
  res <- tryCatch(
    clusterProfiler::simplify(res, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min),
    error = function(e) res   # fall back to unsimplified if simplify fails
  )
  if (nrow(res@result) == 0) return(NULL)
  res
}

# Run KEGG enrichment; return NULL if no significant results
run_kegg <- function(genes, universe) {
  if (length(genes) < MIN_GENES) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene          = genes,
      universe      = universe,
      organism      = "mmu",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = PVAL_CUTOFF,
      qvalueCutoff  = QVAL_CUTOFF,
      minGSSize     = MIN_GSET,
      maxGSSize     = MAX_GSET
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res@result) == 0 ||
      sum(res@result$p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF) == 0) return(NULL)
  res <- setReadable(res, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  # Strip species annotation from KEGG pathway descriptions
  res@result$Description <- sub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "",
                                 res@result$Description)
  # Keep only significant rows (simplify() is GO-specific; filter manually for KEGG)
  res@result <- res@result %>% filter(p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF)
  res
}

# Run MSigDB enrichment via enricher(); return NULL if no significant results
# term2gene: data.frame with columns gs_name, entrez_gene (from msigdbr)
run_msigdb <- function(genes, universe, term2gene) {
  if (length(genes) < MIN_GENES || nrow(term2gene) == 0) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch(
    enricher(
      gene          = genes,
      universe      = universe,
      TERM2GENE     = term2gene,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = PVAL_CUTOFF,
      qvalueCutoff  = QVAL_CUTOFF,
      minGSSize     = MIN_GSET,
      maxGSSize     = MAX_GSET
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res@result) == 0 ||
      sum(res@result$p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF) == 0) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch(
    setReadable(res, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID"),
    error = function(e) res
  )
  res@result <- res@result %>% filter(p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF)
  res
}

# Run Reactome pathway enrichment; return NULL if no significant results
run_reactome <- function(genes, universe) {
  if (length(genes) < MIN_GENES) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch(
    ReactomePA::enrichPathway(
      gene          = genes,
      universe      = universe,
      organism      = "mouse",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = PVAL_CUTOFF,
      qvalueCutoff  = QVAL_CUTOFF,
      minGSSize     = MIN_GSET,
      maxGSSize     = MAX_GSET,
      readable      = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res@result) == 0 ||
      sum(res@result$p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF) == 0) return(NULL)
  res@result <- res@result %>% filter(p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF)
  res
}

# dotplot wrapper with cluster color and guard
safe_dotplot <- function(res, title, col, n = 20) {
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(as.data.frame(res)) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  dotplot(res, showCategory = n, font.size = 10) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = unname(col), high = "grey30") +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11))
}
```

# 4. Load data

## 4-1. Union miRNA–mRNA pairs

```{r load_pairs}
union_csv <- find_union_pairs_csv()
cat("Using:", union_csv, "\n")

pairs <- read.csv(union_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Total pairs:", nrow(pairs), "\n")
cat("Tissues     :", paste(sort(unique(pairs$tissue)),        collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("miRNA clust :", paste(sort(unique(pairs$miRNA_cluster)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 4-2. Tissue-specific universes (all detected genes)

```{r universe}
# Universe = all genes detected in each tissue (nonzero Log2TPM across any sample)
# Source: {tissue}_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv — long format with entrezid column
tissue_universe <- setNames(
  lapply(tissues, function(tis) {
    f <- tryCatch(find_nonzero_csv(tis), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(f)) { cat("Skipped (file not found):", tis, "\n"); return(NULL) }
    df     <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    entrez <- unique(df$entrezid[!is.na(df$entrezid) & df$entrezid != ""])
    entrez <- as.character(entrez)
    cat(tis, "| detected genes:", n_distinct(df$symbol),
        "| Entrez IDs:", length(entrez), "\n")
    entrez
  }),
  tissues
)

tissue_universe <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tissue_universe)
cat("\nTissues with universe loaded:", paste(names(tissue_universe), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 5. Gene lists per tissue × miRNA cluster

```{r gene_lists}
# Nested list: tissue -> miRNA_cluster -> Entrez IDs
tissue_cluster_genes <- lapply(names(tissue_universe), function(tis) {
  tis_pairs <- pairs %>% filter(tissue == tis)
  if (nrow(tis_pairs) == 0) return(NULL)

  clusts <- sort(unique(tis_pairs$miRNA_cluster))
  genes_by_clust <- setNames(
    lapply(clusts, function(cl) {
      syms   <- unique(tis_pairs$SYMBOL[tis_pairs$miRNA_cluster == cl])
      entrez <- symbol_to_entrez(syms)
      entrez
    }),
    as.character(clusts)
  )
  genes_by_clust
})
names(tissue_cluster_genes) <- names(tissue_universe)

# Summary table
summary_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tissue_cluster_genes), function(tis) {
  gc <- tissue_cluster_genes[[tis]]
  if (is.null(gc)) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(gc), function(cl) {
    tibble(tissue = tis, miRNA_cluster = cl, n_genes = length(gc[[cl]]))
  }))
}))

cat("Pairs per tissue × miRNA cluster (Entrez-mapped genes):\n")
summary_tbl %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = miRNA_cluster, values_from = n_genes,
              names_prefix = "clust_", values_fill = 0) %>%
  print()
```

# 6. GO enrichment (Biological Process) per tissue

```{r go_bp_by_tissue, results="asis", fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
go_all_results <- list()

for (tis in names(tissue_universe)) {
  gc      <- tissue_cluster_genes[[tis]]
  univ    <- tissue_universe[[tis]]
  clusts  <- names(gc)

  cat("\n\n## GO BP —", tis, "\n\n")

  res_list <- setNames(
    lapply(clusts, function(cl) {
      g   <- gc[[cl]]
      cat("  cluster", cl, "| n_genes =", length(g), "→ ")
      res <- run_go(g, univ)
      cat(if (is.null(res)) "no result\n"
          else paste(sum(res@result$p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF), "terms\n"))
      res
    }),
    clusts
  )

  # Per-cluster dotplots
  for (cl in clusts) {
    res <- res_list[[cl]]
    p   <- safe_dotplot(res,
                        title = paste0("GO BP — ", tis, " / miRNA cluster ", cl),
                        col   = cluster_colors[cl])
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      print(p)
      ggsave(file.path(dir_go,
                       paste0("GO_BP_", tis, "_cluster", cl, ".svg")),
             p, width = 10, height = 8)
    }
  }

  go_all_results[[tis]] <- res_list
}
```

## GO BP combined table

```{r go_bp_table}
go_bp_all <- bind_rows(lapply(names(go_all_results), function(tis) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(go_all_results[[tis]]), function(cl) {
    res <- go_all_results[[tis]][[cl]]
    if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    as.data.frame(res@result) %>%
      filter(p.adjust < PVAL_CUTOFF) %>%
      mutate(tissue = tis, miRNA_cluster = cl)
  }))
}))

if (nrow(go_bp_all) > 0) {
  write.csv(go_bp_all,
            file.path(dir_go, "GO_BP_tissue_cluster_all.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved: GO/GO_BP_tissue_cluster_all.csv (", nrow(go_bp_all), "terms)\n")
  go_bp_all %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, miRNA_cluster, ID, Description, GeneRatio, p.adjust, geneID) %>%
    arrange(tissue, miRNA_cluster, p.adjust) %>%
    head(40) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("No significant GO BP terms.\n")
}
```

# 8. MSigDB enrichment per tissue

```{r msigdb_load}
# Load MSigDB gene sets (Entrez ID format) for all specified collections
msigdb_term2gene <- lapply(MSIGDB_SETS, function(s) {
  df <- if (is.null(s$subcategory))
    msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = s$category)
  else
    msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = s$category,
            subcategory = s$subcategory)
  t2g <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene) %>%
    mutate(entrez_gene = as.character(entrez_gene)) %>%
    distinct()
  cat(s$label, "| gene sets:", n_distinct(t2g$gs_name), "\n")
  list(label = s$label, term2gene = t2g)
})
names(msigdb_term2gene) <- sapply(MSIGDB_SETS, `[[`, "label")
```

```{r msigdb_by_tissue, results="asis", fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
msigdb_all_results <- list()

for (tis in names(tissue_universe)) {
  gc     <- tissue_cluster_genes[[tis]]
  univ   <- tissue_universe[[tis]]
  clusts <- names(gc)

  cat("\n\n## MSigDB —", tis, "\n\n")
  tis_results <- list()

  for (s_name in names(msigdb_term2gene)) {
    t2g      <- msigdb_term2gene[[s_name]]$term2gene
    cat(" [", s_name, "]\n")

    res_list <- setNames(
      lapply(clusts, function(cl) {
        g   <- gc[[cl]]
        cat("  cluster", cl, "| n =", length(g), "→ ")
        res <- run_msigdb(g, univ, t2g)
        cat(if (is.null(res)) "no result\n"
            else paste(nrow(res@result), "terms\n"))
        res
      }),
      clusts
    )

    for (cl in clusts) {
      res <- res_list[[cl]]
      p   <- safe_dotplot(res,
                          title = paste0(s_name, " — ", tis, " / cluster ", cl),
                          col   = cluster_colors[cl])
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        print(p)
        ggsave(file.path(dir_msigdb,
                         paste0(s_name, "_", tis, "_cluster", cl, ".svg")),
               p, width = 10, height = 8)
      }
    }
    tis_results[[s_name]] <- res_list
  }
  msigdb_all_results[[tis]] <- tis_results
}
```

# 10. Summary

```{r summary}
# Helper: parse "k/n" GeneRatio string → numeric
parse_generatio <- function(gr) {
  sapply(gr, function(x) {
    v <- as.numeric(strsplit(x, "/")[[1]])
    if (length(v) == 2) v[1] / v[2] else NA_real_
  })
}

# Count of significant terms per tissue × cluster
go_summary <- if (nrow(go_bp_all) > 0)
  go_bp_all %>% count(tissue, miRNA_cluster, name = "n_GO_terms") else
  tibble(tissue = character(), miRNA_cluster = character(), n_GO_terms = integer())

kegg_summary <- if (nrow(kegg_all) > 0)
  kegg_all %>% count(tissue, miRNA_cluster, name = "n_KEGG_pathways") else
  tibble(tissue = character(), miRNA_cluster = character(), n_KEGG_pathways = integer())

combined_summary <- full_join(go_summary, kegg_summary,
                              by = c("tissue", "miRNA_cluster")) %>%
  replace_na(list(n_GO_terms = 0L, n_KEGG_pathways = 0L)) %>%
  arrange(tissue, miRNA_cluster)

cat("=== Significant results per tissue × miRNA cluster ===\n")
print(as_tibble(combined_summary), n = Inf)

write.csv(combined_summary,
          file.path(dir_output, "summary_GO_KEGG_counts.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: summary_GO_KEGG_counts.csv\n")

# Top 3 GO terms and KEGG pathways per tissue × cluster
go_top <- if (nrow(go_bp_all) > 0)
  go_bp_all %>%
    group_by(tissue, miRNA_cluster) %>%
    slice_min(p.adjust, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(top_GO = paste(Description, collapse = " | "), .groups = "drop") else
  tibble(tissue = character(), miRNA_cluster = character(), top_GO = character())

kegg_top <- if (nrow(kegg_all) > 0)
  kegg_all %>%
    group_by(tissue, miRNA_cluster) %>%
    slice_min(p.adjust, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(top_KEGG = paste(Description, collapse = " | "), .groups = "drop") else
  tibble(tissue = character(), miRNA_cluster = character(), top_KEGG = character())

top_summary <- full_join(go_top, kegg_top, by = c("tissue", "miRNA_cluster")) %>%
  arrange(tissue, miRNA_cluster)

cat("\n=== Top 3 terms per tissue × cluster ===\n")
print(as_tibble(top_summary), n = Inf)

write.csv(top_summary,
          file.path(dir_output, "summary_top_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: summary_top_terms.csv\n")
```

# 11. Integrated GO + KEGG + MSigDB + Reactome compare plot per tissue

```{r integrated_compare, fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
TOP_N <- 5   # top N terms per source per cluster

# Fixed x-axis: all 5 miRNA clusters, always shown
ALL_CLUSTERS       <- as.character(1:5)
ALL_CLUSTER_LABELS <- paste0("cluster ", ALL_CLUSTERS)

# Source display order in facet
SOURCE_LEVELS <- c("GO BP", "KEGG", "Reactome",
                   paste0("MSigDB:", names(msigdb_term2gene)))

for (tis in names(tissue_universe)) {
  go_tis       <- if (nrow(go_bp_all)    > 0) filter(go_bp_all,    tissue == tis) else data.frame()
  kegg_tis     <- if (nrow(kegg_all)     > 0) filter(kegg_all,     tissue == tis) else data.frame()
  reactome_tis <- if (nrow(reactome_all) > 0) filter(reactome_all, tissue == tis) else data.frame()

  # MSigDB: flatten all collections for this tissue
  msigdb_tis <- if (nrow(msigdb_all) > 0)
    filter(msigdb_all, tissue == tis) %>%
      mutate(source_full = paste0("MSigDB:", msigdb_set)) else
    data.frame()

  make_top <- function(df, src) {
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df %>%
      group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
      slice_min(p.adjust, n = TOP_N, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(source      = src,
             GeneRatio_n = parse_generatio(GeneRatio),
             term_label  = Description)
  }

  # Build per-source top-N frames
  msigdb_rows <- if (nrow(msigdb_tis) > 0)
    bind_rows(lapply(unique(msigdb_tis$msigdb_set), function(s) {
      make_top(filter(msigdb_tis, msigdb_set == s), paste0("MSigDB:", s))
    })) else NULL

  combined <- bind_rows(
    make_top(go_tis,       "GO BP"),
    make_top(kegg_tis,     "KEGG"),
    make_top(reactome_tis, "Reactome"),
    msigdb_rows
  )
  if (is.null(combined) || nrow(combined) == 0) {
    cat("No results for", tis, "— skipped\n"); next
  }

  # Term label order within each source (top p.adjust → bottom), reversed for y-axis
  term_order <- combined %>%
    arrange(source, p.adjust) %>%
    distinct(source, term_label) %>%
    pull(term_label) %>% rev()

  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(
      term_label    = factor(term_label, levels = unique(term_order)),
      cluster_label = factor(paste0("cluster ", miRNA_cluster),
                             levels = ALL_CLUSTER_LABELS),
      source        = factor(source,
                             levels = intersect(SOURCE_LEVELS, unique(source)))
    )

  p <- ggplot(combined,
              aes(x = cluster_label, y = term_label,
                  size = GeneRatio_n, color = p.adjust)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#d73027", high = "#4575b4", name = "p.adjust") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "GeneRatio", range = c(2, 8)) +
    facet_grid(source ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    labs(title = paste0("GO BP + KEGG + MSigDB + Reactome — ", tis),
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines")
    )

  print(p)

  h <- max(8, n_distinct(combined$term_label) * 0.32 + 4)
  ggsave(file.path(dir_output, paste0("all_pathway_compare_", tis, ".svg")),
         p, width = 14, height = h)
  cat("Saved: all_pathway_compare_", tis, ".svg\n", sep = "")
}
```

# 12. Shared genes across pathway databases per tissue × cluster

```{r shared_pathway_genes}
# Extract gene symbols from an enrichResult's significant rows
# geneID column is "/" separated symbols (after setReadable / readable=TRUE)
extract_genes <- function(res) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(character(0))
  df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(res), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(character(0))
  ids <- df$geneID[!is.na(df$geneID) & df$geneID != ""]
  unique(unlist(strsplit(ids, "/")))
}

# Source names (all databases)
src_go       <- "GO_BP"
src_kegg     <- "KEGG"
src_reactome <- "Reactome"
msigdb_src_names <- paste0("MSigDB_", names(msigdb_term2gene))

shared_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tissue_universe), function(tis) {
  gc     <- tissue_cluster_genes[[tis]]
  clusts <- names(gc)

  bind_rows(lapply(clusts, function(cl) {
    # Collect gene sets per source
    gene_sets <- list()
    gene_sets[[src_go]]       <- extract_genes(go_all_results[[tis]][[cl]])
    gene_sets[[src_kegg]]     <- extract_genes(kegg_all_results[[tis]][[cl]])
    gene_sets[[src_reactome]] <- extract_genes(reactome_all_results[[tis]][[cl]])

    for (s_name in names(msigdb_term2gene)) {
      key <- paste0("MSigDB_", s_name)
      gene_sets[[key]] <- extract_genes(
        msigdb_all_results[[tis]][[s_name]][[cl]]
      )
    }

    all_genes <- unique(unlist(gene_sets))
    if (length(all_genes) == 0) return(NULL)

    # Binary presence per source
    presence <- as.data.frame(
      lapply(gene_sets, function(gs) all_genes %in% gs),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    presence$SYMBOL        <- all_genes
    presence$n_sources     <- rowSums(presence[, names(gene_sets)])
    presence$sources       <- apply(
      presence[, names(gene_sets)], 1,
      function(row) paste(names(gene_sets)[as.logical(row)], collapse = ";")
    )
    presence$tissue        <- tis
    presence$miRNA_cluster <- cl

    # Keep only genes shared across ≥2 sources
    presence %>%
      filter(n_sources >= 2) %>%
      dplyr::select(tissue, miRNA_cluster, SYMBOL, n_sources, sources,
                    all_of(names(gene_sets))) %>%
      arrange(desc(n_sources), SYMBOL)
  }))
}))

if (nrow(shared_rows) > 0) {
  write.csv(shared_rows,
            file.path(dir_output, "shared_genes_across_databases.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved: shared_genes_across_databases.csv (", nrow(shared_rows), "rows)\n\n")

  # Summary: count of shared genes per tissue × cluster
  cat("=== Shared genes (≥2 databases) per tissue × cluster ===\n")
  shared_rows %>%
    count(tissue, miRNA_cluster, name = "n_shared_genes") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = miRNA_cluster, values_from = n_shared_genes,
                names_prefix = "clust_", values_fill = 0L) %>%
    print()

  # Top shared genes (most databases)
  cat("\n=== Top shared genes (most databases) ===\n")
  shared_rows %>%
    group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
    summarise(
      n_tissue_cluster = n(),
      max_sources      = max(n_sources),
      databases        = paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(sources, ";")))),
                               collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_sources), desc(n_tissue_cluster)) %>%
    head(30) %>%
    print()
} else {
  cat("No genes shared across ≥2 pathway databases.\n")
}
```
